title: Support Agent With Google ADK
tagline: Build a redacted, authorized support review with retained replies and evidence, then run the same policy through real Google ADK agents.
summary: Build a redacted, authorized support review with retained replies and evidence, then run the same policy through real Google ADK agents.
youWillBuild: An HTML review page and support.json with the redacted ticket, selected capability, source guidance, reply or escalation and state history.
usefulFor: An HTML review page and support.json with the redacted ticket, selected capability, source guidance, reply or escalation and state history.
skills: Route and authorize as separate decisions
Retain the actual response in the handoff
Reuse the policy inside the real ADK path
prerequisites: Python dictionaries, exceptions and module imports.
An async function and an iterator of model events.
The distinction between classifying a request and authorizing a capability.

languageWhy.Python: Stdlib data structures, explicit algorithms and deterministic local tests.

stages.title: Validate before starting a session
stages.summary: For invoice for sam@example.invalid api_key=EXAMPLE_TOKEN, the usable ticket text becomes invoice for [email] api_key=[redacted]. An empty string fails before routing. The same cleaned text must reach both the baseline and ADK path.
stages.languageWhy: Python standard-library collections, bytes and file operations expose this stage directly.

stages.title: Route and authorize as separate decisions
stages.summary: invoice refund selects billing and can use read_invoice. invoice login ties billing and access, so it escalates. A billing route requesting read_account is rejected even though that tool is valid for another specialist.
stages.languageWhy: Python standard-library collections, bytes and file operations expose this stage directly.

stages.title: Retain the actual response in the handoff
stages.summary: begin followed by classify on invoice then respond with Check the invoice reference produces answered and retains response="Check the invoice reference". The history records classify and respond. Classifying invoice login followed by respond fails; escalate is the valid transition.
stages.languageWhy: Python standard-library collections, bytes and file operations expose this stage directly.

stages.title: Reuse the policy inside the real ADK path
stages.summary: A login ticket chooses read_account and access-recovery guidance. The fixture specialist replies using that guidance, and the final handoff stores the reply. A request for read_invoice under the access route raises PermissionError before a graph is run. Optional tests inspect model requests to ensure raw email and example keys did not cross the boundary.
stages.languageWhy: Python standard-library collections, bytes and file operations expose this stage directly.
